hero.title:
A good coffee,
no fuss.
hero.lede: A small, well-kept coffee shop on Rambla de Sant Jordi. Coffee made to order — properly hot or just warm, whichever you prefer — seeded bread for breakfast, and a cool, bright room with music quiet enough to talk over.

about.title:
Small, bright,
and cool when it matters.
about.p1: Cafetería zoe sits on Rambla de Sant Jordi in the centre of Vilanova i la Geltrú. It is a small room that clearly gets looked after: well lit, with music kept low and air conditioning running — which around here in summer is not a small thing.
about.p2: Zoe works the counter and remembers how you take your coffee. Ask for it properly hot and it arrives properly hot; ask for it warm and that is what you get. It is the kind of place you go back to out of habit rather than novelty.
about.note: Coffee, breakfast and something small to eat, served in.

kitchen.title: What people order here
kitchen.lede: No long menu. These are the things that keep coming up when people write about what they had.

visit.title: On Rambla de Sant Jordi
visit.note: It sits right in the centre, a step off the rambla. Coming by car, look for parking on the surrounding streets.
